facts.text: Thomas College's Guaranteed Job Program guarantees graduates a job within six months, or eligible students can take undergraduate courses tuition-free for two years or up to six free graduate courses.

sources.title: Thomas Guarantees: Guaranteed Job After College Graduation
sources.quote: We're so confident in the relevance of our students' education that we can guarantee they will find a job within six (6) months of graduation.

sources.title: Thomas Guarantees: Guaranteed Job After College Graduation
sources.quote: The student may enroll, tuition-free, in an unlimited number of undergraduate courses at Thomas College for up to two (2) years. The student may enroll, tuition-free, in up to six (6) online/evening graduate courses at Thomas College.
